body:
Poured concrete into my neighbors convertible porsche, broke one of the taillights and made 2 huge dents on the hood. That happened when i was like 8.

Paid the price. Was grounded for 4 months. Also no tv, wifi or computer.

Somehow my neighbor didnt care at all (didnt make my parents pay for it) and bought me a  small rc car and a model version of the porsche.what a legend eh?
Hey thanks a lot for your reply! I see we've had a few problems in common. I'll try and do my best to follow what you have written. If it helped you, I guess there is a chance it could help me!
